editorial.blurb: Flo is a beloved Chicago brunch destination where Mexican-American flavors meet exceptional execution, drawing crowds who happily wait for housemade hot sauces, perfectly cooked eggs, and creative drinks.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive right when they open to avoid the wait, or embrace it—regulars say it's worth every minute. The veggie burrito and huevos verdes are customer favorites that justify the standby.
